verdict.rationale: Refunds on agent-placed orders can be tracked programmatically. Shopify pushes signed, retried order webhooks on committed changes, explicitly including refunds, and Token-tier agents can call get_order to read post-purchase adjustments. Nothing in the pack documents an agent or developer API for initiating a refund, and webhook subscriptions are not self-serve: they must be set up through a partner manager. Missing for 10: a documented programmatic refund-initiation tool or API, self-serve webhook registration, and independent hands-on corroboration of refund tracking.

support.subject: As a developer, refunds on agent-placed orders can be initiated and tracked programmatically

citations.quote: Shopify pushes UCP-shaped order webhooks to your registered endpoint whenever an order placed through your agent has a committed change (fulfillment progress, refunds, returns, exchanges, order edits, or cancellations).
The Order MCP server enables AI agents to fetch the current state of an order placed through their agent, including line items, fulfillment events, and post-purchase adjustments.
Failed deliveries are retried up to 8 times over 4 hours with exponential backoff.
